'''Asogians''' were paddle-footed, large-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] indigenous to [[Brodo Asogi]]. During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Asogians were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Grebleips/Legends|Grebleips]] and a trio of [[Senatorial aide|aides]]. When the Republic became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grebleips was charged with treason, and the Asogians' home planet became a part of the autocratic new government. More than twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that pitted the Empire against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], an Asogian [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] named [[Braxas]] operated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Solay]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Braxas3.jpg|thumb|left|[[Braxas]], a yellow-skinned Asogian]]
Asogians were paddle-footed [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]],<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> small-sized and squat, with long arms that could touch the ground as they walked. Their hands ended in four long fingers. Their head, dominated by two large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], was perched atop an extensible neck. Some Asogians had [[Color/Legends|brown]], completely [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] skin,<ref name="TPM" /> while others were yellow-skinned with scattered black hair on the head.<ref name="SW89" /> Possible eye colors included blue<ref name="TPM" /> and red.<ref name="SW89" />

==Society and culture==
Like many other species, including the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] of [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]],<ref name="G7">{{GamerCite|7|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx}}</ref> and the furry [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]] of [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]],<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> the Asogians routinely went about their business [[Clothing/Legends|unclothed]].<ref name="SW89" /><ref name="TPM" /> They used [[Chopstick|grub-sticks]] as eating utensils,<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> and at least some of them consumed meat.<ref name="SW89" />

The physical appearance of the [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK-series worker droid]] was modeled on that of the Asogians.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile2014|9|PKS 1-2|PK-series Worker Droid}}</ref>

==History==
The Asogians hailed from [[Brodo Asogi]],<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Perinn sector/Legends|Perinn sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At some point, they joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the democratic union that governed most of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

==Asogians in the galaxy==
[[File:Brodo_Asogi_Delegation.jpg|Grebleips and the Brodo Asogi delegation in the Galactic Senate|thumb|220px]]
By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Asogians were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Grebleips/Legends|Grebleips]] and three [[Senatorial aide|aides]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onslaught]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="HNN50">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #50]]</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Grebleips notably declared his intention to [[Currency/Legends|fund]] an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] expedition project.<ref name="HNN50" /> At the end of the war, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] the existing regime into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]], with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The Asogian Grebleips and sixty-two other delegates were charged with conspiracy and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] for helping plot the so-called [[Showdown on Coruscant|revolt]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] against Palpatine.<ref name="HNN2">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> Like countless other planets, the homeworld of the Asogians fell into the Galactic Empire's hands.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a disabled Asogian named [[Braxas]] made a career as an [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] on the planet of [[Solay]],<ref name="SW89" /> in the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] seized Solay, the Asogian decided to leave the planet. Braxas then hired [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a young hero of the Alliance and a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], to transport him offworld.<ref name="SW89" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GreenPlanet.jpg|thumb|left|The titular character of ''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'']]
The Asogians originated in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first movie in the [[prequel trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'', as a cameo appearance of the famous aliens of [[Steven Spielberg]]'s [[1982]] film [[Wikipedia:E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial|''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'']]. Those creatures were inserted in the movie to make good on a promise&mdash;after [[Steven Spielberg]] included a [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] cameo and ''Star Wars'' toys in ''E.T.'', [[George Lucas]] promised to include an ''E.T.'' cameo in the next ''Star Wars'' film he made&mdash;''The Phantom Menace''. While this was primarily an [[Easter egg (virtual)|easter egg]], and ''E.T.'' is probably not meant to be taken as part of [[Canon|''Star Wars'' canon]], some ''Star Wars'' references in ''E.T.'' can be reinterpreted in light of the ''E.T.'' references in ''Star Wars''.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|161|Jedi Challenge!}}</ref>

''E.T.: The Book of the Green Planet'', a sequel novel to the movie, reveals "Children of the Green Planet" to be the translated name of E.T.'s species. It also mentions several names which other alien species have given E.T.'s homeworld, such as [[Brodo Asogi]], all of which translate to "Green Planet."<ref name="Green Planet">{{BookCite|author=Kotzwinkle, William|title=E.T.: The Book of the Green Planet|publisher=[[Wikipedia:G. P. Putnam's Sons|G. P. Putnam's Sons]]|date=1985}}</ref> While a species with the same name and appearance is itself part of ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], and the homeworld name is given in ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', the species name is not specified.

When E.T. goes trick-or-treating with the children, he spots a child in a [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] mask and begins to follow that child saying "Home&hellip; home&hellip;" (Composer [[John Williams]] included a snippet of his "Yoda Theme" from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to accompany this scene.) This could be interpreted as E.T. recognizing a [[Yoda's species/Legends|familiar species]] from his home galaxy.<ref name="ET the Ext">{{VisualMediaCite|title=[[Wikipedia:E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial|''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'']]|director=[[Steven Spielberg]]|prod=[[Wikipedia:Amblin Entertainment|Amblin Entertainment]]|year=[[1982]]}}</ref>

[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' 50]] also mentions that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Grebleips/Legends|Grebleips]] of Brodo Asogi funded an expedition to another galaxy. This is another reference to ''E.T.'', since E.T. visits [[Wikipedia:Earth|Earth]] from [[Wikipedia:Milky Way|another galaxy]] in the film.

The name of the Senator itself, 'Grebleips', is 'Spielberg' spelled backwards.

[[Pat Welsh]], the woman who did the voice for E.T. in ''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'', also did the voice for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] as disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

In his novella ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'', author [[Abel G. Peña]] mentioned "a pair of Asogian grub-sticks," which was specifically meant to refer to the chopsticks used by Braxas in [[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]. In doing this, Peña simultaneously named the species and confirmed Braxas as one of them.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52361960|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-05-04|time=4:30 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314000518/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/page-7}}</ref>

E.T. also made a cameo appearance in "[[Hate Leads to Lollipops]]," a light-hearted comic story by [[David McCaig]], where he was seen among the patrons of the [[Mon Calamari Fish Market]]. That particular panel also included characters belonging to other science-fiction movies, namely Derek from [[Wikipedia:Teenagers from Outer Space|''Teenagers from Outer Space'']], the Mutant from [[Wikipedia:This Island Earth|''This Island Earth'']], and Mac from [[Wikipedia:Mac and Me|''Mac and Me'']].<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|DaveMcCaig|status/605030372318035968|[[David McCaig]]|quote=@lelalmekha Haha! Yay, someone spotted him. Derek from Teenagers From Outer Space is in that panel too, & the mutant from This Island Earth.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ycmGP }}</ref>
